body_markdown:
Is your frame rate or artboard layout basically your entire personality at this point? Then you are not alone. Every visual storyteller has their daily routine, whether editing raw footage or tweaking color profiles. These tools on your desk should celebrate the art you create every day.


Starting today, Logitech is bringing a true tribute to visual storytellers. We’re dropping a limited-edition


[MX Master 4 Creator Edition](https://logi.link/1eb0f3) wrapped in studio artboard design, and we’ll be at Adobe MAX in Miami Beach. Come by to check out the limited edition and our MX ecosystem as we celebrate the artists shaping our culture.


#### **Powerful MX Master 4 Performance, Custom Creator Styling**


- **Studio vibe:** Features layout grids, color calibration bands and alignment crosshairs printed directly on the mouse, giving your desk a true physical-artboard aesthetic.


- **The Easter Eggs:** Subtle keyframe timestamp tributes integrated into the body to celebrate World Design Day (04:27), World Photography Day (08:19), and World Creativity Day (04:21)


- **Built on MX Master 4 Performance:**


- **Tactile timeline navigation:** Built-in haptic vibration feedback while scrubbing timelines, adjusting sliders or making granular image edits.


- **Instant shortcut access:** A dedicated Actions Ring button offering one-click access to custom macros, color wheels and shortcuts for their generative AI tools.


- **Flow through tasks:** Scroll up to 1,000 lines per second and stop on a pixel with the MagSpeed Scroll Wheel, Logitech’s fastest1, quietest and most precise2 scrolling experience.


#### **Availability**


If you’re heading to Adobe MAX in Miami Beach from November 10–12, stop by our booth to be the first to purchase the MX Master 4 Creator Edition, test your workflow at our creator stations and take a selfie with the Mega MX Master 4 Mouse. This limited drop goes live starting November 9 on


[Logitech.com](https://logi.link/1eb0f3) or in select global retailers for $119.99 USD/ €119/£119.99, as well as in person at Adobe MAX while supplies last.


#### **About Logitech**


Logitech creates design-led, software-enabled hardware solutions that help businesses thrive and bring people together when working, creating and gaming in the age of AI. As the point of connection between people and the digital world, our mission is to extend human potential in work and play, in a way that is good for people and the planet. Founded in 1981, Logitech International is a Swiss public company listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (LOGN) and on the Nasdaq Global Select Market (LOGI). Find Logitech and its other brands, including Logitech G, at


[www.logitech.com](http://www.logitech.com/) or


[company blog](http://blog.logitech.com/) .
